basic_info.description: Welcome to Westwood Park's Finest! Perched at the corner of Miramar & Northwood, this thoughtfully renovated home offers over 3000 Sq feet of living space on 3 floors. Westwood Park was developed between 1917-1923 by Baldwin & Howell, a prominent SF developer at the time. 800 Miramar was one of the first homes to be built. Built in 1918, this bungalow style home sits on a prominent Southwest facing, 5000+ sq foot corner lot. The property is completely detached & features a free standing, two car garage, + two additional off street parking spots. The main level features a foyer, large, renovated eat-in kitchen, formal dining room, living room + fireplace, two bedrooms & full bath. The current owners expanded the home to include two en suite bedrooms downstairs, an exercise room, laundry area & vault. The piece de resistance is the top floor: a large, airy den or office space with windows on all sides. Take in views from the Bay to the Pacific & the surrounding neighborhood. This room also has a gas burning fireplace. The hardscaped patio is nicely sheltered from the wind. It features slate tile,a Japanese elm, & koi pond w/waterfall. The home has dual pane Marvin windows throughout. Hardwood floors, architectural windows, & coved ceilings contribute to the home's timeless elegance
